description: Decode the number of sequences of a zstd compressed block from its 1- to 3-byte header
notes: zstd 1.5.6, the SeqHead part of ZSTD_decodeSeqHeaders (lib/decompress/zstd_decompress_block.c): one byte below 0x80, two bytes as ((b0 - 0x80) << 8) + b1, or 0xFF followed by a 16-bit little-endian value plus LONGNBSEQ (0x7F00). The three header bytes are parameters; the bounds checks against the end of the input and the pointer updates are dropped. Written by us from the function. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake keeps two branches and a phi: 18 IR instructions. Whether a shorter form exists is unknown.
